verdict.text: The work achieved its primary goal. The most important lesson is that deterministic preprocessing reduces LLM rediscovery effort.

evidence_scope.boundaries: Single session, full transcript, no compaction.

episodes.event: Session had no timestamps in chat_history.jsonl.
episodes.impact: Temporal ordering uses line order only.

recurring_patterns.description: Loose pattern matching caused detector false positives.
recurring_patterns.causal_interpretation: Regex/window thresholds too permissive for real coding sessions.

confidence_rationale.evidence_confidence: Signal counts dropped from 617 to 111 after tightening.
confidence_rationale.intervention_confidence: Tighter patterns plausibly reduce noise; rare cases untested.
confidence_rationale.scope_confidence: Pattern applies to detector design generally but evidence is one session.

opportunity_candidates.title: Calibrate detector thresholds against a labelled corpus
opportunity_candidates.observed_evidence: Smoke run produced 617 signals before tuning; signal-to-noise was poor.
opportunity_candidates.interpretation: Calibration against a labelled true-positive corpus would let us set per-detector thresholds with evidence.
opportunity_candidates.value_expected: Higher precision; fewer false positives reaching the LLM synthesis stage.

confidence_rationale.evidence_confidence: One session shows noise reduction but not precision.
confidence_rationale.scope_confidence: Single session cannot establish general applicability.

opportunity_candidates.falsifier: Calibration may not generalise if the labelled corpus is drawn from a different problem class.
opportunity_candidates.next_evidence_needed: Build a small labelled corpus and measure precision before/after.

lifecycle.hypothesis: Calibrated thresholds reduce false positives without losing true positives.
lifecycle.evidence_needed: Labelled corpus of 50+ transcripts with known true-positive signals.
lifecycle.success_signal: Precision improves by ≥30% at constant recall on the labelled corpus.
lifecycle.failure_signal: Precision does not improve or recall drops materially.
lifecycle.review_trigger: After 3 detector changes or a labelled corpus of 50 transcripts.
lifecycle.retirement_condition: If thresholds converge and no further calibration is measurable.
